subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.
The fear of open spaces or crowds.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Agoraphobia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Agoraphobia"** refers to an intense fear of open spaces or crowds, often leading to avoidance behavior. (खुले स्थानों या भीड़ का डर)
 
 
• **Example:** She avoids going to shopping malls due to her agoraphobia.
 
 
• It is a psychological condition that causes anxiety in situations where the person feels trapped, helpless, or embarrassed.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2 i.e. Agoraphobia**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Arachnophobia** (मकड़ियों का डर): The fear of spiders.
 
 
• **Example:** He screamed when he saw a spider due to his arachnophobia.
 
 
 
• **Astraphobia** (बिजली या तूफान का डर): The fear of thunder and lightning.
 
 
• **Example:** During the storm, she stayed indoors because of her astraphobia.
 
 
 
• **Pyrophobia** (आग का डर): The fear of fire.
 
 
• **Example:** He hesitates to light candles due to his pyrophobia.
